notes.title: v1.04
notes.notes:
Fixes
-Crash caused by ending level 3. 
-End cutscene crash 
-Tai Song not completing mission after loading save 
-Some minor path finding issues for land units 
-Minor text corrections. 

Changes 
-Stock Market has been tamed for balancing purposes.  

Hopefully this is the last rush patch I will need to do. However if need be I will of course do another one. From now the patches will be less frequent (as I can't sustain pushing out a patch every 1-2 days) but the extra time will allow me to add more content to the game and test additional areas. 
As always let me know of any issues if you are running v1.04.

Andy
